svg.title: Slope field of dv/dt equals 9.8 minus 0.28 v, for t from 0 to 20 seconds and v from 0 to 50. Segments along each row are parallel, steep near v equals 0, horizontal on the dashed line v equals 35 and falling above it. The solution curve starts at the origin, rises steeply, then flattens and levels off just below v equals 35.
